claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Kodiak 之後的申報寫出這批燃機交貨權／採購承諾被轉讓出去、取消，或改用電網／其他電源。核查頻率：每季（Kodiak 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀燃氣渦輪發電機組層的需求側。
claims.statement: Kodiak 10-Q (Q2 2026): purchase commitments for new compression and power generation units ordered but not received were USD 2.5 billion at 2026-06-30 (USD 587.9 million within twelve months), including the multi-year Baker Hughes power generation arrangement. The 10-Q does not split power generation from compression, and does not itself say 'gas turbine' — the turbine identification comes from the 2026-07-08 joint release.

source_doc.title: Kodiak Gas Services, Inc. Form 10-Q（2026Q2，2026-08-07）：採購承諾 25 億美元（新壓縮與發電機組），內含 Baker Hughes 多年期發電方案安排

sources.quote: Purchase commitments primarily consist of future commitments to purchase new compression and power generation units that have been ordered but not yet received.
As of June 30, 2026, these commitments amounted to $ 2.5 billion, of which $ 587.9 million is expected to be settled within the next twelve months.

Included within these future commitments is a multi-year strategic arrangement whereby Baker Hughes will provide power generation solutions to support Kodiak’s expanding energy infrastructure initiatives.
